finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a filename with a path traversal or a command injection payload.
finding.assumptions: The filename is directly passed to fopen without any validation or sanitization.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a very large file size, leading to a buffer overflow when allocating memory.
finding.assumptions: The filesize is read from the file and directly used to allocate memory without any validation.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a file content that is not a valid s-expression, leading to an error.
finding.assumptions: The file content is directly passed to gcry_sexp_new without any validation.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a file content that is not a valid s-expression, leading to a double free.
finding.assumptions: The file content is freed even if gcry_sexp_new fails.
